{{Top|leg}}
'''Manax trees''' were trees native to [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]], and were planted on all of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]]. They, along with [[Harvester beetle/Legends|harvester beetles]], were an integral source of the fungi that gave the Neimoidians their riches.<ref name="LOE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>
